title: alwaysStrict / strict leaves nested scopes in sloppy mode (RecursiveSetStrictMode early-exit) → Annex B var can shadow outer bindings
author: fringe4life
body_preview: ## Summary  When TypeScript `alwaysStrict` / `strict` is enabled, esbuild marks **only the module scope** as strict.
